seo.title: Homeless help in San Antonio - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified help in San Antonio for people experiencing homelessness: shelter, meals, showers, health care, benefits, jobs, ID, legal help, youth, veterans, and pets.

page.heading: San Antonio homeless and housing-crisis help
page.urgent: Immediate danger, fire, police, or ambulance: 911 Shelter and Homelink access: 210-207-1799 Haven for Hope: 210-220-2100 Food, benefits, and local referrals: 211 Mental-health or substance-use crisis: 210-223-7233 or 800-316-9241 Domestic violence: 210-733-8810
page.notice: Beds, schedules, routes, costs, and eligibility can change. Call before traveling when possible. No listing guarantees a bed, meal, treatment, benefit, money, or job the same day. Call 911 for immediate danger or a medical emergency.
page.intro: If you have nowhere safe to sleep, call the City of San Antonio Community Connections Hotline at 210-207-1799. Ask for Homelink and say where you are, who is with you, whether anyone is pregnant or under 18, medical or mobility needs, veteran status, pets, and whether you have identification. An assessment or referral is not a promise of a bed or permanent housing.
page.footer: No Home Help is an open-source directory, not an emergency service or service provider. Listings do not guarantee eligibility or availability.

entries.title: Emergency services — 911
entries.description:
Phone: 911.
Call for: immediate violence, serious injury, overdose, trouble breathing, unconsciousness, fire, or another life-threatening emergency. Give the exact location and describe the danger first.
San Antonio Police Department contact guidance

entries.title: Community Connections Hotline and Homelink
entries.description:
Phone: 210-207-1799; published call hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
Use it for: homeless-services navigation, shelter options, Homelink housing assessment, outreach referrals, and health or social-service connections.
In-person Homelink: Haven for Hope, 1 Haven for Hope Way, Monday–Friday, 7 a.m.–3 p.m. American GI Forum also lists limited assessment hours at 610 North Main Avenue, Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, 8:30–11:30 a.m.
Close to Home — current access points

entries.title: 211 Texas
entries.description:
Phone: 211; choose option 1 for local resources or option 2 for state benefits.
Ask for open shelter, food today, health care, benefits, rent or utility help, or a service near you. Ask the operator to confirm hours, eligibility, documents, and space before traveling.
211 Texas

entries.title: Center for Health Care Services crisis line
entries.description:
Phone: 210-223-7233 or 800-316-9241, 24 hours.
For a mental-health or substance-use crisis, assessment, and direction to the right care in Bexar County. Call 911 for immediate physical danger or a medical emergency.
Center for Health Care Services

entries.title: San Antonio 311
entries.description:
Phone: 311 or 210-207-6000.
For city services, cooling or warming locations, outreach questions, and non-emergency local information.
San Antonio 311

entries.title: Street outreach
entries.description:
Request through: Community Connections at 210-207-1799 or 311.
Give a precise location, description, time last seen, mobility or health concerns, and whether there is immediate danger. Outreach is not an emergency response and cannot guarantee transport, shelter, or housing.
City homeless resource directory

entries.title: Extreme heat — cooling locations and water
entries.description:
Current locations: call 311 or 210-207-6000. Libraries, senior centers, and community centers may be cooling locations during normal hours.
Heat emergency signs: confusion, fainting, seizure, very hot skin, or inability to drink. Call 911, move to shade or air conditioning, loosen clothing, and cool the person.
Project Cool fans for eligible older adults: call 211. A fan is not safe as the only cooling method in extreme indoor heat.
City heat guidance

entries.title: Cold weather and severe-weather shelter
entries.description:
Current city information: call 311, 210-207-1799, or 211. Locations and activation thresholds change with the event.
Corazon: may extend hours or provide severe-weather shelter when activated; call 210-904-8001, extension 200.
Emergency signs: confusion, slurred speech, very slow breathing, or inability to wake. Call 911 and move the person somewhere dry and sheltered.
City cold-weather response

entries.title: Haven for Hope — central homeless-services campus
entries.description:
Main phone: 210-220-2100; accommodation questions: 210-220-2357.
Published walk-in intake: Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Services can include shelter, meals, showers, health care, documents, benefits, employment, recovery support, case management, and pet kennels.
After hours: a parent or guardian with minor children should speak with Security. A single adult may ask at the South Gate about courtyard pre-intake; this is limited, short-term safe sleeping and does not guarantee admission to a residential program.
North-campus residential eligibility and south-campus courtyard access are different. Bring any ID, medicine, and documents you have, but call if documents are missing. Ask about accessibility, bags, couples, pets, and capacity.
Haven for Hope — get help
entries.address: Intake: 1 Haven for Hope Way, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: Homelink coordinated housing assessment
entries.description:
Phone: 210-207-1799, Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
In person: Haven for Hope, Monday–Friday, 7 a.m.–3 p.m.; American GI Forum, 610 North Main Avenue, Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, 8:30–11:30 a.m.; or another current access point.
The assessment is for possible referral to housing programs. It does not guarantee immediate shelter, a voucher, or permanent housing. Keep your phone number and usual location current.
Close to Home — Homelink

entries.title: SAMMinistries — emergency shelter and housing programs
entries.description:
Shelter access: call Community Connections at 210-207-1799.
Services: low-barrier emergency shelter, rapid re-housing, permanent supportive housing, veteran programs, and prevention assistance. Each has separate capacity and eligibility.
Rapid re-housing information: 210-377-1616. A call or assessment does not guarantee placement or financial help.
SAMMinistries — how we help

entries.title: San Antonio Rescue Mission — men
entries.description:
Phone: 210-222-9865.
Published evening process: line up around 3:30 p.m.; check-in begins around 4 p.m., subject to capacity. The program states that a picture ID and Social Security number are requested.
Overnight shelter for men, shower, clean clothing, chapel, evening meal, and morning food. It is a Christian ministry; call first for admission, sobriety, health, bag, and ID rules.
San Antonio Rescue Mission
entries.address: Address: 907 East Quincy Street, San Antonio, TX 78215

entries.title: Family Violence Prevention Services — confidential shelter
entries.description:
24-hour crisis line: 210-733-8810.
Safety planning, emergency shelter, counseling, legal help, and support for adults and children affected by domestic violence. The shelter address is confidential. Call 911 for immediate danger and use a safer device if yours may be monitored.
Family Violence Prevention Services

entries.title: Opportunity Home San Antonio — public and assisted housing
entries.description:
Phone: 210-477-6000.
Applications for public housing and other affordable properties; Housing Choice Voucher applications only when that waiting list opens. Opportunity Home warns that waits may be two to seven years.
Apply only through the official portal, save the confirmation, and keep contact and household information current. There is no fee to join a waiting list.
Opportunity Home — apply for housing

entries.title: Corazon Day Center — weekday lunch
entries.description:
Phone: 210-904-8001, extension 200.
Published lunch: Monday–Friday, noon–1 p.m. The center also offers weekday case management, showers on selected days, identification help, and severe-weather services.
Corazon Day Center — current services
entries.address: Address: 504 Avenue E, San Antonio, TX 78215

entries.title: Christian Assistance Ministry — sack lunches and groceries
entries.description:
Phone: 210-223-6648.
Published sack-lunch schedule: Monday–Saturday, 9–11 a.m. CAM also lists groceries, clothing, hygiene supplies, showers, prescriptions, utility help, birth-certificate help, and mail for enrolled clients.
Services can close early when daily limits are reached. Confirm which campus provides the help you need.
Christian Assistance Ministry — services
entries.address: Downtown campus: 110 McCullough Avenue, San Antonio, TX 78215

entries.title: Church Under the Bridge — evening meals
entries.description:
Published meals: Sunday, Tuesday, and Friday at 6 p.m.; schedule can change.
Clothing distribution is listed for the first and third Tuesday at 4 p.m. This is a Christian street ministry and not a housing program.
Church Under the Bridge — current schedule
entries.address: Address: 724 Chestnut Street, San Antonio, TX 78202

entries.title: San Antonio Food Bank — find food and benefits help
entries.description:
Client Services: 210-431-8326 or 800-246-9121.
Published phone hours: Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; Saturday, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.
Ask for a nearby pantry or distribution, SNAP or Medicaid help, job training, senior food, or pet food. Do not assume the warehouse provides walk-in groceries at every hour; call or use the locator.
San Antonio Food Bank — get help
entries.address: Address: 5200 Historic Old Highway 90, San Antonio, TX 78227

entries.title: St. Stephen's CARE Center — client-choice pantry
entries.description:
Phone: 210-226-6178.
Published hours: Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–noon and 1–4 p.m. Hours, household limits, and required information may change; call first.
Catholic Charities — St. Stephen's Food Pantry
entries.address: Address: 2127 South Zarzamora Street, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: Haven for Hope meals
entries.description:
Phone: 210-220-2100.
Meals are part of campus and courtyard services. Access depends on enrollment or courtyard rules; ask intake or the South Gate about current access.
Haven for Hope
entries.address: Address: 1 Haven for Hope Way, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: 211 — open food today
entries.description:
Phone: 211.
Give your ZIP code or nearest cross streets and ask for a meal or pantry open today, plus transport and document requirements. Call the referred provider before a long trip.
211 Texas food referrals

entries.title: Corazon Day Center — showers and case management
entries.description:
Published showers: Tuesday and Thursday, 9 a.m.–noon; Sunday, 8–11:30 a.m.
Other help includes weekday case management, lunch, identification recovery, hygiene items, and extended severe-weather service. Capacity can be limited.
Corazon Day Center
entries.address: Address: 504 Avenue E, San Antonio, TX 78215

entries.title: Christian Assistance Ministry — showers, clothing, hygiene, and mail
entries.description:
Phone: 210-223-6648.
Published showers: Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday, 9:30–11:30 a.m.; Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday, 1–3 p.m.
Other help includes clothing, hygiene kits, food, limited prescriptions and utilities, ID recovery, and mail for people enrolled as homeless clients. Arrive early and confirm capacity.
CAM services
entries.address: Address: 110 McCullough Avenue, San Antonio, TX 78215

entries.title: Haven for Hope — basic needs and partner services
entries.description:
Phone: 210-220-2100.
Services can include showers, laundry, clothing, meals, mail, computers, benefits, health care, and case management for eligible campus or courtyard clients.
Haven for Hope campus services
entries.address: Address: 1 Haven for Hope Way, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: San Antonio Public Library — internet, charging, and Enhanced Library Card
entries.description:
Central Library: 600 Soledad Street; phone: 210-207-2500.
Public computers, Wi-Fi, charging where available, information help, and library cards. The Enhanced Library Card is accepted by some local agencies as supplemental ID; it is not a state ID or proof of immigration status.
Enhanced Library Card

entries.title: VIA Metropolitan Transit — fares and reduced fares
entries.description:
Customer service: 210-362-2020.
Published local-bus fare: $1.30 standard or $0.65 reduced; transfers are free within the published limit. Confirm before travel.
Reduced fare requires an eligible VIA Reduced Fare ID. Low income alone is not listed as a qualification. Some service agencies may provide passes.
VIA fares | Reduced-fare eligibility — https://www.viainfo.net/reduced-fares/

categories.title: Health, dental, mental health, and recovery

entries.title: CentroMed Sarah E. Davidson Clinic at Haven for Hope
entries.description:
Phone: 210-220-2330.
Primary care and related health services for people using the Haven campus. Call for hours, eligibility, appointments, identification, and cost.
City health and homeless resource directory
entries.address: Address: 1 Haven for Hope Way, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: CommuniCare West Campus
entries.description:
Phone: 210-233-7000.
Medical, dental, behavioral-health, and community health services. Ask about same-day care, sliding fees, insurance enrollment, language help, and documents.
CommuniCare West Campus
entries.address: Address: 1102 Barclay Street, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: Center for Health Care Services — mental health and substance use
entries.description:
24-hour line: 210-223-7233 or 800-316-9241.
Walk-in crisis care: 601 North Frio Street. CHCS states that people are not denied service because they cannot pay and sliding fees may apply. Call first when possible.
Center for Health Care Services

entries.title: San Antonio Christian Dental Clinic
entries.description:
Phone: 210-220-2300.
Free dental care for adults who meet eligibility rules. Treatment is by appointment; call for screening, documents, referral rules, and capacity.
San Antonio Christian Dental Clinic
entries.address: Address: 1 Haven for Hope Way, Building 1, Suite 400

entries.title: University Health CareLink
entries.description:
Phone: 210-358-3350.
A financial-assistance program for Bexar County residents who are uninsured and do not qualify for other coverage. CareLink is not insurance and enrollment is not automatic.
University Health CareLink

entries.title: Alpha Home — substance-use treatment for women
entries.description:
Phone: 210-735-3822.
Residential and outpatient treatment and recovery support for women. Call about assessment, funding, pregnancy or medication needs, children, and waiting time.
Alpha Home

entries.title: Lifetime Recovery — substance-use treatment
entries.description:
Phone: 210-734-6362.
Adult residential and outpatient treatment and recovery support. Call about admission, detox needs, fees or funding, medications, ID, and beds.
Lifetime Recovery

entries.title: San Antonio Council on Alcohol and Drug Awareness
entries.description:
Phone: 210-225-4741.
Prevention, education, recovery support, and referral. Ask what is offered directly and where to obtain clinical assessment or treatment.
SACADA

entries.title: Your Texas Benefits — SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, and health programs
entries.description:
Help with SNAP, Medicaid or CHIP, TANF cash help, Medicare Savings Programs, and application status. Save the application number and report contact changes.
Your Texas Benefits
entries.how_to_access: Apply: through the official state portal or call 211 and choose option 2.

entries.title: Social Security — replacement card, SSI, and SSDI
entries.description:
Phone: 800-772-1213, Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–7 p.m.
Ask about a replacement card, SSI or SSDI, a missing payment, changing a mailing address or direct deposit, and a local-office appointment. Never pay for an appointment.
Social Security office locator

entries.title: City of San Antonio Rental Assistance
entries.description:
Phone: 210-207-6459.
The city opens its online portal for a limited period, normally the second Wednesday of the month from 1–2 p.m.; holidays can change this. Check the official page for the next opening.
Eligibility includes a current Notice to Vacate or eviction court citation and other listed documents. Funding is limited. Applying does not stop a court case; request legal help immediately.
City Rental Assistance

entries.title: City Utility Assistance
entries.description:
Phone: 210-207-8198.
Limited CPS Energy and SAWS help for income-eligible households. Priority includes households with young children, people with disabilities, or adults age 60 and older. Call about documents and missing-document alternatives.
City Utility Assistance
entries.address: Office: 1302 North Zarzamora Street, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: San Antonio Food Bank benefits assistance
entries.description:
Phone: 210-431-8326.
Screening and application help for SNAP, Medicaid, and other programs, plus food referrals. Ask what identity, income, and household information is needed.
San Antonio Food Bank help

entries.title: Workforce Solutions Alamo — South Central Career Center
entries.description:
Phone: 210-436-0670; published hours: Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.
Job search, computers, resumes, recruitment events, skills assessment, unemployment information, training referrals, and support-service screening. Ask what is available without ID or a permanent address.
Workforce Solutions Alamo locations
entries.address: Address: 7008 Marbach Road, San Antonio, TX 78227

entries.title: Goodwill San Antonio Career Centers
entries.description:
Phone: 210-924-8581.
Free employment help, computers, resumes, interviews, job matching, career coaching, and training information at multiple centers. Call for current walk-in hours and documents.
Goodwill employment services
entries.address: Central location: 406 West Commerce Street, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: Ready to Work
entries.description:
Apply or ask questions: 311 or 210-207-6000.
Training, education, coaching, and support services for eligible San Antonio residents age 18 or older who are authorized to work in the United States and meet income rules.
Screening and enrollment take time; training is not a paid job. Ask about transport, childcare, documents, high-school equivalency, and career paths.
Ready to Work San Antonio

entries.title: Project QUEST
entries.description:
Phone: 210-630-4690.
Support for eligible participants completing approved training for in-demand careers, possibly including tuition, books, supplies, testing, transport, and case management.
Support depends on eligibility and an approved plan; the program does not pay wages for time spent in training.
Project QUEST services

entries.title: NXT Level Youth Opportunity Center — ages 16–24
entries.description:
Phone: 210-207-1723; published hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.
Employment, education, career navigation, mentoring, mental-health and other support for young people disconnected from work or school. The city states that a permanent address is not required.
NXT Level
entries.address: Address: 1226 Northwest 18th Street, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: Christian Assistance Ministry — ID recovery and mail
entries.description:
Phone: 210-223-6648.
Published ID intake: Wednesday starting at 9:30 a.m., limited to the first 15 people. Arrive early and confirm.
Help obtaining identity documents and a mailing address for people enrolled as homeless clients. Ask what CAM can pay for and what evidence to bring.
Close to Home — ID recovery options
entries.address: Address: 110 McCullough Avenue, San Antonio, TX 78215

entries.title: San Antonio Hope Center — ID recovery
entries.description:
ID assistance: 210-271-2704.
Published schedule: Monday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; Tuesday and Thursday, 9–11:30 a.m. The broader resource center is listed Monday and Wednesday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.
Main campus: 321 North General McMullen Drive; 210-732-3776. Confirm location, eligibility, capacity, and papers.
Close to Home — document help
entries.address: Downtown service point: First Presbyterian Church, 404 North Alamo Street

entries.title: SAPD HOPE Team — ID referral and outreach
entries.description:
Phone: 210-207-6329; email: sapdhopeteam@sanantonio.gov. — mailto:sapdhopeteam@sanantonio.gov
Outreach and referral for people experiencing homelessness, including possible ID-recovery referral. This is not an emergency line; call 911 for immediate danger.
Close to Home — HOPE Team contact

entries.title: City Right to Counsel — eviction legal help
entries.description:
Phone: 210-212-3703; email: righttocounsel@trla.org. — mailto:righttocounsel@trla.org
Free legal help for eligible San Antonio residents facing eviction, through Texas RioGrande Legal Aid. Contact them as soon as you receive a notice or court papers; assistance applications do not pause an eviction case.
San Antonio housing legal assistance

entries.title: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid
entries.description:
Phone: 833-329-8752 or 956-996-8752, weekdays, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.
Free civil legal help for eligible low-income people, including housing, benefits, family safety, employment, and consumer matters. Acceptance depends on issue, deadlines, conflicts, and capacity.
Texas RioGrande Legal Aid — get help

entries.title: Enhanced Library Card — supplemental local identification
entries.description:
Available at: Bazan, Carver, Johnston, and Westfall library branches. Call 210-207-2500 for appointment and document rules.
The card may help identify you to participating local organizations, but it does not replace a Texas ID, driver's license, passport, Social Security card, or immigration document.
Enhanced Library Card

categories.title: Women, families, youth, veterans, seniors, and immigrants

entries.title: Family Violence Prevention Services — domestic violence
entries.description:
24-hour crisis line: 210-733-8810.
Confidential emergency shelter, safety planning, counseling, children's services, transitional help, and legal advocacy. Call 911 for immediate danger.
Family Violence Prevention Services

entries.title: Rape Crisis Center
entries.description:
24-hour crisis line: 210-349-7273.
Confidential crisis support, advocacy, counseling information, and accompaniment for survivors of sexual assault.
Rape Crisis Center

entries.title: Youth and Young Adult Services — ages 18–24
entries.description:
Published hours: Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.
Housing navigation and age-specific help for young adults experiencing homelessness. Ask Community Connections at 210-207-1799 about current access.
Close to Home — young adult access
entries.address: Address: 1919 Northwest Loop 410, Suite 100, San Antonio, TX 78213

entries.title: Veterans — National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
entries.description:
Phone: 877-424-3838, 24 hours.
Connection to VA homeless programs, outreach, health care, shelter referrals, and housing assistance for veterans and people calling on their behalf.
Local South Texas VA: 210-617-5300.
VA homeless veterans call center

entries.title: Endeavors — Supportive Services for Veteran Families
entries.description:
Phone: 210-469-9664; published hours: Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m.
Homelessness prevention and rapid re-housing for eligible very-low-income veterans and families. Screening, funding, documents, and capacity apply.
Endeavors veteran services
entries.address: Address: 3201 Cherry Ridge Drive, Building A, Suite 101

entries.title: Bexar County Military and Veterans Services Center
entries.description:
Phone: 210-335-6775.
Benefits claims, referrals, and navigation for veterans, service members, and families. Call for appointments and discharge-document needs.
Bexar County veterans services
entries.address: Address: 1422 East Grayson Street, San Antonio, TX 78208

entries.title: Older adults and people with disabilities
entries.description:
City Senior Services: 210-207-7172; Alamo Service Connection: 210-477-3275.
Ask about meals, transport, benefits, caregiver support, adult protective services, and help remaining safe.
San Antonio Senior Services

entries.title: The Arc of San Antonio — intellectual and developmental disabilities
entries.description:
Phone: 210-490-4300.
Case management, family support, day services, employment and other disability resources. It is not an emergency shelter.
The Arc of San Antonio
entries.address: Address: 13430 West Avenue, San Antonio, TX 78216

entries.title: RAICES — immigration legal services
entries.description:
Phone: 833-372-4237.
Immigration legal screening and representation in selected matters. A call does not create an attorney-client relationship or guarantee representation.
RAICES contact
entries.address: Address: 131 Interpark Boulevard, San Antonio, TX 78216

entries.title: Caritas Legal Services — immigration help
entries.description:
Phone: 210-433-3256.
Nonprofit immigration legal services through Catholic Charities. Ask about consultation, fees, documents, interpretation, and whether the office handles your case type.
Caritas Legal Services
entries.address: Address: 110 Bandera Road, San Antonio, TX 78228

entries.title: Haven for Hope — limited kennel and cattery
entries.description:
Phone: 210-220-2100.
Limited kennel and cattery space for pets of enrolled clients. Call about capacity, species, vaccines, behavior, supplies, and service-animal accommodation.
Haven for Hope campus
entries.address: Address: 1 Haven for Hope Way, San Antonio, TX 78207

entries.title: DaisyCares pet food assistance
entries.description:
Request through Food Bank Client Services: 210-431-8326.
Pet-food assistance through participating food programs when supplies are available. Ask for the closest distribution, dates, eligibility, and stock.
DaisyCares Pet Food Program

entries.title: San Antonio Animal Care Services
entries.description:
Phone: 210-207-4738 or 311.
Ask about urgent animal welfare, lost pets, surrender prevention, pet-pantry events, low-cost services, and options if you may lose housing. Intake and pantry supply are not guaranteed.
Animal Care Services
entries.address: Address: 4710 State Highway 151, San Antonio, TX 78227

entries.title: Spay Neuter Network — low-cost veterinary care
entries.description:
Free or low-cost spay/neuter and low-cost vaccines and wellness services. Published vaccine and wellness hours are Tuesday–Friday, 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; surgery requires an appointment.
Confirm phone, appointment, residency, income, species, and payment requirements on the official site.
Spay Neuter Network — San Antonio
entries.address: Clinic: 210 Tuleta Drive, Building 3, San Antonio, TX 78212

entries.title: Sources and corrections
entries.description:
Information was checked against official government, health-system, transit, housing-authority, and provider pages on November 12, 2026. Main directories used include:
- City of San Antonio Homeless Services Resource Directory
- Close to Home homeless-response resources — https://closetohomesa.org/find-resources/
- Haven for Hope — get help — https://www.havenforhope.org/get-help/
- San Antonio Food Bank — get help — https://safoodbank.org/help/
- City renter support — https://www.sa.gov/Directory/Departments/NHSD/Housing-Support/Renter-Support
Found an error or change? Do not send medical, immigration, benefits, or identity documents. Report the specific listing, correct phone, schedule, eligibility rule, or closed service through GitHub issues. Include an official source when possible. — https://github.com/carlosbranco/no-home-help/issues
